title: CORS trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for cors trace events.

pageOrigin.description: Origin of the page whose JavaScript makes the call (scheme + host + port).

apiOrigin.description: Origin of the API being called.

crossOrigin.description: Whether the two origins differ, i.e. whether CORS applies at all.

policy.description: The CORS headers the API answers with.

allowOrigin.description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: an origin, '*', or null when the header is not sent.

exposeHeaders.description: Access-Control-Expose-Headers: response headers JavaScript may read.

maxAge.description: Access-Control-Max-Age in seconds; 0 when the header is not sent.

request.description: The call being made (absent before the first one).

headers.description: Request headers as the fetch call set them.

safelisted.description: Whether this header is on the CORS request safelist, i.e. does not trigger a preflight.

credentials.description: Whether the call was made with credentials: 'include' (cookies attached).

wantsHeaders.description: Response headers the JavaScript intends to read.

needsPreflight.description: Whether the method or headers force an OPTIONS preflight first.

outcome.description: How far the current call got and what the browser decided.

stage.description: How far the call has progressed: just issued, delivered to the handler, or finally decided.

preflight.description: State of the OPTIONS handshake, or null when no preflight was needed.

delivered.description: Whether the real request reached the server and the handler ran.

readable.description: Whether JavaScript is allowed to read the response.

reason.description: Technical code for why the browser blocked the call; null when nothing was blocked.

detail.description: The offending origin, method or header name behind `reason`; empty when not applicable.

hiddenHeaders.description: Response headers the JavaScript asked for but may not read.

stats.description: Running totals across the whole run.

reachedServer.description: Calls whose real request was delivered and executed by the server.

blockedByBrowser.description: Calls whose response JavaScript was not allowed to read.

preflightsSaved.description: Preflights skipped because Access-Control-Max-Age was still valid.
